title: Vector-Valued Period Polynomials and Zeta Values of Quadratic Fields
summary: Let $k\ge 2$ and $N\ge 1$ be integers. Let $D$ be a positive integer that is congruent to a square modulo $4N$, and fix $ρ$ with $ρ^2\equiv D\pmod{4N}$. In this paper, we consider two weight $2k$ cusp forms $f^{\pm}_{k,N,D,ρ}$ on $Γ_0(N)$ defined by sums over binary quadratic forms, and investigate the vector-valued period polynomial arising from these forms. Our first main result gives a closed formula for this vector-valued period polynomial.
